svg.title: CompleteBin default model architecture
svg.desc: Four feature streams feed four encoders; their outputs concatenate to 3072 dimensions, pass through a two-layer projector widening to 6144 then narrowing to a 100-dimensional L2-normalized embedding.
svg.text: Trained on the train tower + MLPs + projector; pretrain tower frozen
AdamW betas (0.8, 0.95), lr 1e-5 ×10 warmup, batch 700, ~35 base epochs
